# BondoMod v0.2.10

- Detect validated Rocket League installations on Steam, Epic Games and Heroic, including custom locations on other drives.
- Confirm the detected EXE and CookedPCConsole folder once after updating. Detect again or select both paths manually in Settings.
- Remove the previous update announcement and connection apology screens.
- Fix equipped presets with fewer than five items and retain learned item recovery for duplicate match reservations.
- Keep important recognition and recovery details in support reports.

The spawner fixes passed automated regression tests; the two reported user cases still need confirmation on their PCs. Owned RLCS / Esports decals may still reset spawned item colours after a goal. Use a normal or spawned decal if affected.
